version.description: API version. Events and the format of their payloads are versioned. Please see the webhooks docs.

status.description: The status of the rule. Rules can be enabled or disabled.

created.description: Unix timestamp representing the date and time of creation of the rule.

modified.description: Unix timestamp representing the date and time of last modification of the rule.

ruleType.description: The type of rule. In this case AWS Kinesis. See the Ably integrations docs for further information.

requestMode.description: Single request mode sends each event separately to the endpoint specified by the rule. You can read more about single request mode events in the batching docs.

region.description: The region is which AWS Kinesis is hosted. See the AWS documentation for more detail.

streamName.description: The name of your AWS Kinesis Stream.

partitionKey.description: The AWS Kinesis partition key. The partition key is used by Kinesis to route messages to one of the stream shards. See this Ably FAQs for details.

enveloped.description: Delivered messages are wrapped in an Ably envelope by default that contains metadata about the message and its payload. The form of the envelope depends on whether it is part of a Webhook/Function or a Queue/Firehose rule. For everything besides Webhooks, you can ensure you only get the raw payload by unchecking "Enveloped" when setting up the rule.
